# railway_function (Resource)

A Railway Function, as `railway.Fn`: a single TypeScript file that runs on Railway's Bun function image with no repository or build step. The source travels in the deploy start command, so `deploy.start_command` cannot be set. Accepts the other service settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "environment_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "railway_function" "hook" {
  environment_id = var.environment_id
  name           = "hook"
  code           = "export default { fetch() { return new Response(\"ok\") } }"

  shared_variables = {
    WEBHOOK_SECRET = "WEBHOOK_SECRET"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) TypeScript source of the function, such as `file("hook.ts")`. Railway runs it on the Bun function image. At most 98295 bytes of UTF-8 (`railway.FunctionSourceMaxBytes`).
- `environment_id` (String) ID of the Railway environment that holds this service. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the service. Railway IaC addresses resources by name, so renaming replaces it.

### Optional

- `build` (Attributes) Build settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--build))
- `cdn` (Attributes) Edge caching for the service's public domains, as `railway.ServiceCdn`. Applies without a deploy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cdn))
- `cluster_display` (Attributes) How the canvas labels a cluster member. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_display))
- `cluster_role` (String) Role in a cluster: `root`, `replica`, `internal` or `edge`.
- `config_file` (String) Path of a Railway config file in the repository.
- `custom_domains` (Attributes Map) Custom domains keyed by host name. The SDK defaults `port` to `8080`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_domains))
- `deploy` (Attributes) Deploy settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deploy))
- `group` (String) Name of the canvas group the service belongs to.
- `image` (String) Function runtime image to pin instead of `runtime`, such as `ghcr.io/railwayapp/function-bun:1.2.16`.
- `num_replicas` (Number) Replica count in the service's default region. Conflicts with `replicas`.
- `parent_service_id` (String) ID of the service this one is a cluster member of.
- `preserve_variables` (List of String) Variables Railway keeps with their current values, as `railway.Preserve()`. Use for secrets set outside Terraform.
- `replica_config` (Attributes) Scaling bounds for a cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--replica_config))
- `replica_stackers` (Map of String) Stacker assignment per region, for regions listed in `replicas`.
- `replicas` (Map of Number) Replica count per region, such as `{ "us-west2" = 1 }`.
- `runtime` (String) Runtime image from `railway.FunctionImages`. Defaults to `bun`. Conflicts with `image`.
- `service_domains` (Attributes Map) Railway-generated `*.up.railway.app` domains keyed by host name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_domains))
- `shared_variables` (Map of String) Variables that reference an environment shared variable, keyed by variable and valued by shared variable name, as `railway.Shared`.
- `tcp_proxies` (List of Number) Application ports exposed through Railway's TCP proxy.
- `tracing` (Attributes) OpenTelemetry tracing switches. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tracing))
- `variable_references` (Attributes Map) Variables that reference another resource's output, as `railway.Ref`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variable_references))
- `variables` (Map of String) Variables with literal values. Railway expands `${{service.VAR}}` templates in values.
- `volume_mounts` (Map of String) Volumes keyed by mount path and valued by `railway_volume` name. Reference the volume (`railway_volume.data.name`) so Terraform orders the two. Backup schedules cannot be set through the SDK's volume mounts.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<environment_id>/<address>`, for example `c2b9…/service.web`.
- `live_changes` (List of String) Changes Railway needs to match this configuration, as `railway config plan` lists them. Empty after an apply; a refresh fills it when the live environment drifts, and the next plan applies them.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the Railway project the environment belongs to.
- `railway_id` (String) Railway's ID for this service.

<a id="nestedatt--build"></a>
### Nested Schema for `build`

Optional:

- `build_command` (String) Command that builds the service.
- `build_environment` (String) Builder generation: `V2` or `V3`.
- `builder` (String) `RAILPACK`, `DOCKERFILE`, `NIXPACKS`, `HEROKU` or `PAKETO`.
- `dockerfile_path` (String) Path of the Dockerfile, relative to the root directory.
- `nixpacks_config_path` (String) Path of the Nixpacks configuration file.
- `nixpacks_version` (String) Nixpacks version.
- `railpack_version` (String) Railpack version.
- `watch_patterns` (List of String) Paths whose changes trigger a deploy.


<a id="nestedatt--cdn"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cdn`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Cache responses at Railway's edge.

Optional:

- `default_ttl_seconds` (Number) Seconds to keep a response without its own `Cache-Control`. Railway's default is 7200.
- `html_caching` (String) `auto`, `force` or `never`.
- `purge_on_deploy` (String) `off`, `html` or `all`.
- `stale_while_revalidate` (Boolean) Honour `stale-while-revalidate`. Railway's default is `true`.


<a id="nestedatt--cluster_display"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster_display`

Optional:

- `badge` (String) Badge text.
- `badge_variant` (String) `primary`, `secondary` or `muted`.


<a id="nestedatt--custom_domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_domains`

Optional:

- `port` (Number) Target port. `0` lets Railway pick the port the service listens on.


<a id="nestedatt--deploy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deploy`

Optional:

- `cron_schedule` (String) Cron schedule for a service that runs on a schedule.
- `draining_seconds` (Number) Seconds an old deploy keeps running after it stops receiving traffic.
- `healthcheck_path` (String) Path Railway polls before routing traffic to a deploy.
- `healthcheck_timeout` (Number) Seconds a deploy has to pass its health check.
- `ipv6_egress_enabled` (Boolean) Allow outbound IPv6.
- `limit_override` (Attributes) Per-container resource limits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deploy--limit_override))
- `overlap_seconds` (Number) Seconds the old and new deploys both receive traffic.
- `pre_deploy_command` (List of String) Commands run before each deploy.
- `registry_credentials` (Attributes, Sensitive) Credentials for a private image registry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deploy--registry_credentials))
- `restart_policy_max_retries` (Number) Restarts allowed under `ON_FAILURE`.
- `restart_policy_type` (String) `ON_FAILURE`, `ALWAYS` or `NEVER`.
- `sleep_application` (Boolean) Sleep the service when it receives no traffic.
- `start_command` (String) Command that starts the service.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <environment_id>/service.<name>
terraform import railway_function.hook 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/service.hook
```
